title: Force Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The force F(r) must be correctly expressed for both regions of r.

title: Potential Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The potential energy V(r) must be derived correctly for both regions of r.

title: Turning Points
description: Important Criteria: The turning points must be correctly calculated and interpreted in relation to the bullet's motion.

title: Differential Angle
description: Important Criteria: The expression for the differential orbit angle dθ must be derived correctly.

title: Orbit Equation
description: Important Criteria: The orbit equation r(θ, R) must be obtained through proper integration.

title: Sketch of V(r)
description: Optional Criteria: A sketch of the potential energy V(r) should be included to illustrate the behavior of the function.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common sign errors in force or potential energy expressions must be avoided.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
